title: Beef patties with tomato and pea salad

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food: potatoes, peas, mince, onion, garlic, tomatoes, oil, vinegar and herbs.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday supermarket item in July, and frozen peas would stand in if fresh ones are hard to find.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a saucepan, a frying pan, a knife and a board, and shaping and frying patties is simple.

works.reason: 500g mince makes eight sensible patties for four, and the fry and boil times are right; the steps never say to serve the drained potatoes, but any cook would put them on the plate.

honest_times.reason: Thirty minutes covers the chopping, shaping, frying and salad, and the 15-minute boil fits the cook time, though podding peas bought in the pod would push it.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, nothing unlisted is used, and the names match their ids.

seasonal_feel.reason: A raw July tomato salad with 500g of tomatoes is a real part of the plate, not a garnish, and suits a summer evening.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are brief, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Beef patties with new potatoes and a tomato and pea salad make a balanced family dinner.
